newsitem.title: USA: GT Bicycles names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: GT Bicycles names new CFO.

text.p: GT Bicycles Inc said on Thursday it had named Charles Cimitile as chief financial officer.

Cimitile succeeds Michael Haynes, who was appointed president and chief executive in July after the company's chairman and chief executive Richard Long was killed in an automobile accident. Cimitile was most recently chief financial officer of Cruise Phone Inc.
GT also named William Duehring, formerly vice president of product development, to the position of chief operating officer. Cimitile and Duehring will report to Haynes.
